stem.en: Two boxes of masses 3 kg and 2 kg are tied together by a string on a floor with no friction. A force of 10 N pulls them. What is their acceleration, in m/s²?

explanation.en: Treat the two boxes as one system of mass 3 kg + 2 kg = 5 kg. Only the external force of 10 N matters. a = F / (m1 + m2) = 10 N / 5 kg = 2 m/s².

hints.en: Add the two masses first. Then use a = F / m.
